questionText: Choose the correct meaning of the idiom: 'To chew the cud of reflection'
solution:
The correct answer is Option 3 (Pondering deeply).

The idiom "To chew the cud of reflection" means to think deeply or meditate over something. It originates from the behavior of cows chewing cud, which metaphorically represents careful and prolonged consideration.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Pondering deeply.

questionText: Choose the correct one-word substitute for: 'Extremely old-fashioned; belonging to a time before the biblical flood'.
solution:
The correct answer is Antediluvian.

The word "Antediluvian" means extremely old - fashioned or outdated; it refers to something that existed before the biblical flood.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Antediluvian.

subject: English Comprehension
questionText:
Find the part of the sentence that contains an error:
Rarely had the court encountered a petition (1)/ so devoid of legal merit, nor so conspicuously intended (2)/ to attract media attention rather than judicial remedy. (3)/ No error (4)
solution:
The correct answer is Option 2.

The error lies in part 2 of the sentence. The phrase "so devoid of legal merit, nor so conspicuously intended" is incorrect because "nor" is used incorrectly in this context without a preceding "neither". Here, "and" would be appropriate instead of "nor" to maintain grammatical parallelism.

Correct Sentence: "Rarely had the court encountered a petition so devoid of legal merit, and so conspicuously intended to attract media attention rather than judicial remedy."
conceptTested: Correct usage of coordinating and correlative conjunctions in negative sentence structures.

subject: English Comprehension
questionText:
A sentence is provided in direct speech. From the four given options, choose the one that most accurately conveys the sentence in its corresponding indirect speech.
He said to me, "You should work harder."

options.A: He said me that I should work harder.
options.B: He told me that I should work harder.
options.C: He told me that you should work harder.
options.D: He told that I should work harder.
options.a: He said me that I should work harder.
options.b: He told me that I should work harder.
options.c: He told me that you should work harder.
options.d: He told that I should work harder.

solution:
The correct answer is Option 2.

Indirect Speech: He told me that I should work harder.
Key Conversions: - "You should work harder" becomes "I should work harder" as the pronoun "You" converts to "I" to match the perspective of the person being addressed. - Reporting verb "said to me" converts to "told me".
Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2.
conceptTested: Rules of changing direct speech statements containing modal verbs into indirect speech.

subject: English Comprehension
questionText:
A sentence is provided in indirect speech. From the four given options, choose the one that most accurately conveys the sentence in its corresponding direct speech.
The diplomat said that only after the ceasefire would negotiations begin.

options.A: "Negotiations begin only after the ceasefire, " said the diplomat.
options.B: "Only after the ceasefire, negotiations would begin, " said the diplomat.
options.C: "Only after the ceasefire will negotiations begin, " said the diplomat.
options.D: "Negotiations would begin once the ceasefire is announced, " said the diplomat.
options.a: "Negotiations begin only after the ceasefire, " said the diplomat.
options.b: "Only after the ceasefire, negotiations would begin, " said the diplomat.
options.c: "Only after the ceasefire will negotiations begin, " said the diplomat.
options.d: "Negotiations would begin once the ceasefire is announced, " said the diplomat.

solution:
The correct answer is Option 3.

Indirect Speech: The diplomat said that only after the ceasefire would negotiations begin.
Key Conversions: - The modal verb "would" in indirect speech converts to "will" in direct speech. - The phrase "only after the ceasefire" retains its position to preserve the emphasis.
Correct Sentence: "Only after the ceasefire will negotiations begin, " said the diplomat.
conceptTested: Rules for converting indirect speech back to direct speech, adjusting modal verbs (would to will) and sentence structure.
